privacy_entity.label: Privacy mode switch
privacy_entity.description: The camera's Privacy switch (tapo_control creates it as switch.<camera>_privacy). While it is on, the lens is closed and the image sensor and IR LEDs are off.

fixed_config.power: {{ 1.95 if is_state('[[privacy_entity]]', 'on') else (3.32 if is_state('sun.sun', 'below_horizon') else 2.23) }}

measure_description: Measured manually with a Shelly Plus Plug UK, polling its Switch.GetStatus apower every 2 s and averaging, with the camera on its own USB adapter (the adapter's draw is included). Privacy mode on: 1.95 W; watching by day (night vision forced off, colour image): 2.23 W; watching at night (night vision forced on, IR LEDs lit, black-and-white image): 3.32 W. 60-90 s per state after settling, repeated privacy readings agreed within 0.05 W. tapo_control exposes no day/night sensor, so with night vision on auto the sun is used as the proxy for IR. Firmware 1.4.2 Build 260302.
name: Tapo C125 AI Home Security Wi-Fi Camera
